name: Two-colour brush
blurb: Black brush marker, mint blocks, squiggle camo
mechanism: Every line is a fat, wobbling, blob-ended black marker ribbon, and the only other ink is flat mint green laid as a second plate that slips a few pixels off those lines, on cream paper.

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: every line; solid hair, trousers, shoes, hoodies, lids

palette.name: Mint
palette.role: offset second plate, highlight dashes, floor bands, stickers

palette.name: Off-white
palette.role: shirts and upholstery under camo, toe caps, glints, bubbles

line: Filled marker ribbons, never strokes: outlines 5.7-6.8 px, hands and small props 3.3-4.9, details and camo 2.2-3.1, floor 7.4-8.2; width wobbles ±34% with blob ends 26-78% wider.
rules: Two inks only: black #141412 and mint #4fd592 on cream
Every line is a wobbly filled ribbon with blobby ends
Mint blocks slip 2-10 px off the outline
Solid black hair, trousers, shoes with mint highlight dashes
Crinkly squiggle camo only on off-white areas
Chunky profile people: big nose, dot eye, big hands and feet
